plan.notes: QUARTER CREDITS. Source: Academy College 2025-2027 Catalog (34th edition, effective July 7, 2025), BS Business Administration Online program outline (OBSBA). Catalog section minimums sum exactly to the catalog header total of 180 quarter credits (Accounting 12 + Business Course 6 + Areas of Concentration 18 + Technical Electives 36 + Business Major Courses 54 + General Education 54). The catalog outline is not semester-sequenced; sections below use the catalog's own section names. Per-course prerequisites are not published in the program outline (prereq left empty; see course descriptions in catalog for details). Elective blocks are modeled as single choice slots at the catalog's stated block-credit value. QUARTER MODELING NOTE: the catalog publishes program outlines by curriculum section, not a term-by-term map. The 12 quarters above are an editorial distribution of all catalog-listed courses/sections (~15.0 quarter credits each); confirm sequencing with an advisor. All credits are QUARTER credits.
